biggest_catch: You sell below face value at whatever rate their instant quote offers — the 'instant' appeal means accepting a thinner rate than a patient marketplace listing might net.
catches: Rates are instant-quote only (127 brands) — no published rate table, so you accept or decline whatever is offered.
Typical instant-offer sites pay 65-85% of face value; niche brands less — never face value.
Submission does not guarantee acceptance; verification can reject suspicious or duplicate cards.
Electronic payouts only — no cash; processing times vary by payout provider.
Fraud-prevention review can delay or reject unusual submissions; only legally obtained cards accepted.

who_pays: CardSell pays you directly — it's an instant-buy service, not a marketplace with a third-party buyer. Per CardSell's own app description, payout goes straight to your PayPal.
who_qualifies: US sellers with eligible, unused gift cards from supported brands (127 brands listed); your card must pass balance, validity, and ownership verification.

what_gets_accepted: Cards are accepted only after passing balance, validity, and ownership checks — submission doesn't guarantee acceptance, and fraud-prevention review can reject suspicious or duplicate cards. Only legally obtained cards qualify.

when_cash_arrives: Electronic payout is sent after your card is verified and your sale approved — CardSell's own app description states payout within 48 hours directly to your PayPal; arrival time varies by payout provider.
